## Checklist

- [ ] Title follows Conventional Commits
- [ ] PR is small and focused (one logical change)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; patch coverage >= 80%
- [ ] Docs / README / CHANGELOG-relevant notes updated where needed
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or `.env` content included
- [ ] Breaking change? Marked with `!` and a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer, migration notes included
